name: vben-build-dashboard
description: A lightweight web dashboard for managing branches and building monorepo projects

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w backend
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w backend
scripts.bridge: npm run build -w backend && node backend/dist/bridge.js
